content: Gemini CLI 0.60.0. Official policy (geminicli.com tos-privacy, March 2026 X post): using Gemini CLI OAuth/Google login from third-party software is a ToS violation; sanctioned third-party routes are ACP (gemini --acp, JSON-RPC over stdio, client passes its own MCP server at initialize), A2A, and headless -p mode; for direct integration use a Gemini API key or Vertex. @google/gemini-cli-core is not a supported SDK. Headless Coder SDK (@headless-coder-sdk/*) is a community wrapper.
